verdict.rationale: Airweave is an agent retrieval and context layer over synced data, so expiring stale content or weighting results by recency is a fair question for it. The evidence documents only syncing, vector search and agentic search. Nothing in the pack mentions TTLs, expiration dates, decay or recency weighting. Automatic syncing that keeps data current is an adjacent behavior, not the expiry/decay capability itself, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As a developer, I can make memories expire or decay — via TTL, expiration dates, or recency weighting — so stale facts stop surfacing
